MODULE EXAMPLES

模块示例

每个模块集中维护 Python/C++ 完整程序；接口页只保留短请求结构。

工艺、工程和任务示例使用统一字段定义。调用前先阅读工艺分组与工艺、工件分组、接口依赖和示例环境。

field_create.py/cpp 使用示例环境的设备配置、分组 28、工艺 114/115 和工程 27 展示完整数据结构。程序默认离线；显式创建只新增独立记录并回读，不调用任务 Action。

按模块运行完整程序

完整源代码只在下方各模块维护一处，Python/C++标签选择整段可运行程序；接口页面链接过来，不再重复初始化或终端命令。示例数据仅用于理解格式，接入实际设备前需提供当前环境的有效输入。

运行约定

本节是可选 SDK 模块参考，不是接入系统的前置步骤。用户自建程序可直接使用 ROS 2 或 rosbridge，见构建与运行。仅复用本节程序时，按 Python SDK 或 C++ SDK 准备依赖。在独立 API 目录中设置 A=.。普通示例默认离线；查询使用 --connect，可能操作设备的程序必须显式指定 --execute、--download 或控制子命令。随附设备输入仅允许连接隔离 mock；生产环境必须使用单独准备并确认的输入。

焊机控制

examples/data/device-control.json 的 welder 对象包含完整请求格式：weld_ip、certificate、电流 200 A、分别模式 0、电压 20 V、使能 1，以及当前配置结构要求的 power/wire 范围和 welding_process_type=0。这些数值仅用于隔离 mock，不是生产焊接参数。连接生产焊机前，先按焊机查询、配置与连接顺序取得目标型号的量程和模式，并确认面板 P19 设置。

步骤调用与目的进入下一步的判断
1welder_config：先保存设备地址/量程/模式status200及原始message；不是连接
2welder_connect(ip,true)：等待连接、认证、安全恢复和缓存恢复当前连接恢复确认status200/result1；断开分支响应result0（最终状态须回读）；超时不重试、不推断断开
3welder_certify(serial)：核对序列号status200/result1；当前connect也已自动认证
4welder_robot_ready(true)：设置发给焊机的准备信号status200；result为当前缓存位，不代表机器人本体就绪
5welder_current(200)、welder_synergic_mode(0)、welder_voltage(20)每次status200；模式0是分别调节，面板P19需现场配合
6welder_enable(1)：打开服务端后续命令门控status200/result1；不是此刻直接写硬件使能
7welder_welding(true)，再welder_status("is_arcing")起弧命令status200仅处理成功，查询result1才是当前弧状态确认
8welder_welding(false)，再welder_status("weld_operate")熄弧命令status200仍不证明停机，查询result0才是当前停止状态
9welder_enable(0)、welder_robot_ready(false)status200；关闭result0正常；不自动断开设备
python3 "$A/examples/python/welder.py"  # 离线
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_welder"          # 离线
# 下两条命令只连接已启动的隔离 mock；生产设备不得使用随附输入
python3 "$A/examples/python/welder.py" --execute --endpoint-prefix /api_device_mock --input "$A/examples/data/device-control.json"
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_welder" --execute --endpoint-prefix /api_device_mock --input "$A/examples/data/device-control.json"

随附文件的 demonstration_only:true 只允许隔离 mock。生产环境必须另行提供完整输入，设置 demonstration_only:false、site_confirmed:true 并显式执行；这些标志不替代设备安全检查。程序打印每次 status/result/message 并核对状态；任一步错误、解析失败、状态不符或超时均返回非 0，不自动重试。异常后必须单独确认焊机弧状态和设备状态。

这是一条独立手动控制教学流程，不是“机器人运动时同时焊接”的自动作业程序。自动作业服务按工程/工艺负责运动、参数和起熄弧，不应与手动客户端并发控制。

机器人控制

同一文件的 robot 对象使用 Aubo、示例控制器和本机 IP、scope=1000，以及 move_step 的 X/direction=1/speed=20。robot_subtype 必填，示例值为 i7；SDK 原样发送，不补默认值。direction 是带符号的步进距离，不只是方向标志。执行前必须确认目标型号、位置和角度单位、TCP 及设备互锁。

流程：init_robot → connect(true) → power(true) → subscribe → status解析并检查连接/上电/采样 → pose检查三组六元素 → move_step → move_stop → status。上电成功仍可能带默认负载/TCP未应用警告，例程保留打印并停止后续运动（这是示例的保守规则，不把服务端200改成失败）；不要把三个布尔状态当安全许可。步进Service响应不是所有驱动到位保证，停止也不停止焊机。

python3 "$A/examples/python/robot.py"                  # 离线
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_robot"                         # 离线
python3 "$A/examples/python/robot.py" --execute --endpoint-prefix /api_device_mock --input "$A/examples/data/device-control.json"
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_robot" --execute --endpoint-prefix /api_device_mock --input "$A/examples/data/device-control.json"

move_line 和 move_joint 同时提供 Service 与 Action。此模块演示 move_step Service；运动 Action 另有位置反馈和 waitArrival 结果，当前 C++ SDK 未提供专用封装，可直接使用 rclcpp_action 和随附 Action 定义接入。

3D相机与点云

相机 Python 示例统一放在 examples/python/camera/。68 个 config 命令目录 提供每条命令的独立脚本，读取示例无需参数；设置示例采用原值写回与回读核对，电机、激光等用例需先核对现场条件。完整扫描使用 camera_scan_demo.py，运行方式和结果格式见扫描说明。

3D 相机与线激光使用不同协议。先调用 search，从 /at/camera_node/sensor_search_result 的 std_msgs/String.data JSON 数组取得设备 GUID；连接配置文件至少包含 command_type:"connect" 和目标设备 guid，其他 VZ 配置字段按目标驱动填写。没有有效 GUID 时不要执行连接或采集。

python3 "$A/examples/python/camera/camera_capture.py"          # 离线
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_camera_capture"                 # 离线
# 显式采集：CONFIG 是目标环境的 VZ 配置文件，不是随附演示数据
python3 "$A/examples/python/camera/camera_capture.py" --execute --config CONFIG.json --seconds 1
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_camera_capture" --execute --config CONFIG.json --seconds 1

采集程序按connect → connect_status=1 → start_capture → 指定采集间隔 → stop_capture；开始成功不等于已有可下载点云。异常后采集是否仍在运行可能未知，不自动连接或重试。APP点云文件使用HTTP下载，取得world.pcd后解析显示；相机采集示例不自动下载文件，也不等同于扫描业务已完成。

工艺设置与关联

process_inspect读取实际工艺ID的详情及独立配置，检查两份JSON对象并保留原返回字符串；ID须来自process_list_query或目标部署，不使用示例0。

python3 "$A/examples/python/process_inspect.py" --connect --source-id "$PROCESS_ID"
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_process_inspect" --connect --source-id "$PROCESS_ID"

此程序只查询：process_detail 不含写入字段 configParam，嵌套 ID 由数据库管理，不能直接回写到 add/update。完整创建请求使用 field_create 模块和 field-create-templates.json。多层多道输入的 seams[].process_id 转换为 node.weld_process_id，随后逐位置核对 process_vec。

工程管理

先列工程或工件库，再用返回的实际ID查询详情；engineering只读，不将详情原样回写：

python3 "$A/examples/python/engineering.py" --connect --kind project
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_engineering" --connect --kind project
python3 "$A/examples/python/engineering.py" --connect --kind workpiece --id "$WORKPIECE_ID"
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_engineering" --connect --kind workpiece --id "$WORKPIECE_ID"

成功后打印原始 JSON。project 包含 workpieces，工件包含 nodes 焊缝，节点包含基准 path 及排道/工艺引用；保存工程不表示任务已下发。完整任务对象见 multipass 程序和 expected-task.json。工程详情中的字符串 ID、工件查询的 welds 数组与写入时的 JSON 字符串必须按接口分别转换。

独立测试工程的编辑（仅数据库）

工程可以通过 API 新建、查询和编辑，不需要先在界面手工建工程。先用 field_create.py 新建带唯一 APIDOC_VERIFY_ 名称的测试工程并回读，再使用工程编辑示例：

# API 根目录；将 ID/旧名称/新名称替换为本次创建并回读的值。
python3 examples/python/project_edit.py --project-id "$PROJECT_ID" --expected-name "$OLD_NAME" --name "$NEW_NAME"
# 默认只显示离线计划；明确需要写测试工程时才增加 --write。

该程序仅允许 APIDOC_VERIFY_ 测试工程：详情查询 → 核对 ID、名称及四个自动启动开关为整数0 → 完整更新 → 再次详情回读。它把 task_name 映射为写入顶层 name，把 project.id 从字符串转换为整数，同时保留全部工件 ID、节点、关联和扩展字段；不会提交 Task Action、启动任务或删除工程。不适用于工件库 welds 对象的更新。

更新不是 PATCH：不完整 workpieces 可能删除关联；因此不能只发送名称或一个工件。服务没有版本比较锁，请勿让其他客户端同时编辑这个工程。超时、返回 ID 不一致或回读不一致时停止，不自动重试、删除或回滚。数据库中的旧示例轨迹、TCP 或设备绑定仍不是获准执行的现场作业。

自动作业下发与控制

multipass组装任务、校验工艺回读、提交ATWeldTask、处理反馈及结果；共享演示输入默认只能离线。control是单独显式控制方，调用前核对当前project.uid，不自动暂停/继续/停止，也不自动重发任务。

python3 "$A/examples/python/multipass.py"               # 本地格式组装
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_multipass" "$A/examples/data/multipass-input.json"
# 使用目标环境输入并完成安全检查后，才可由操作方显式指定 --execute
python3 "$A/examples/python/control.py" get_task_status # 只读
"$A/.build/cpp/aotai_cpp_control" status                 # 只读

任务direct_run0时下发仍会读取工艺并预规划，业务101007等待显式task_start；101003运行、101004暂停、ROS4+101006正常完成。task_pause/continue/destroy分别受当前状态约束；continue可能实际运动，task_destroy异步停止/禁用不等于急停。恢复先查询UID及状态，不自动重新下发。完整步骤见多层多道的源程序及码表。

多层多道

输入examples/data/multipass-input.json包含第三方提供的基准直线、层/道编号、每道偏移和工艺ID；双程序转换成相同expected-task.json。排道index是全局顺序，layer是层号，DB bead_num必须按层内累计。轨迹固定窄坐标契约、global_process共面mode1，没有任意每道轨迹直接导入能力。

显式执行前用真实系统配置/TCP/工艺引用替换0，确认坐标和单位，回读工艺并逐位置校验order/layer/bead；服务端运行期还会查DB覆盖工艺。SDK不排序掩盖DB无ORDER BY，不承诺快照或消除回读后修改竞态。详细字段由排道数据类型维护；执行限制见SDK契约。

数据创建（不下发、不执行）

完整示例文件：examples/python/field_create.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create four isolated field-validation records; default mode is offline.

The online path only creates a process group, an ordinary process, a
multi-pass process, and a project definition.  It never submits or starts a
task.  A timeout after a create request leaves the database outcome unknown,
so the program stops without retrying or cleaning up.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import json
import math
import re
from pathlib import Path


DEFAULT_INPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data/field-create-templates.json"
RUN_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,47}\Z", re.ASCII)
SAFE_SWITCHES = (
    "direct_run",
    "loop_execution",
    "need_reservation",
    "need_digital_start",
)


class ValidationError(ValueError):
    """The local template or a server reply violates the documented contract."""


def load_template(path: Path) -> dict:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError("template root must be a JSON object")
    for key in ("reference_environment", "group", "ordinary_process", "multipass_process", "project"):
        if not isinstance(payload.get(key), dict):
            raise ValidationError(f"template.{key} must be a JSON object")
    return payload


def validate_run_id(run_id: str) -> None:
    if not RUN_ID_RE.fullmatch(run_id):
        raise ValidationError(
            "--run-id must be 1..48 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen and start alphanumeric"
        )


def _require_safe_project(project_payload: dict) -> None:
    project = project_payload.get("project")
    workpieces = project_payload.get("workpieces")
    if not isinstance(project, dict):
        raise ValidationError("template.project.project must be an object")
    if not isinstance(workpieces, list) or len(workpieces) != 2:
        raise ValidationError("template.project.workpieces must contain ordinary and multipass entries")
    for key in SAFE_SWITCHES:
        value = project.get(key)
        if type(value) is not int or value != 0:  # bool is intentionally rejected
            raise ValidationError(f"project.{key} must be integer 0")
    for index, workpiece in enumerate(workpieces, 1):
        if not isinstance(workpiece, dict) or not isinstance(workpiece.get("nodes"), list):
            raise ValidationError(f"workpieces[{index - 1}] must have a nodes array")
        if not workpiece["nodes"]:
            raise ValidationError(f"workpieces[{index - 1}].nodes must not be empty")


def prepare_payloads(template: dict, run_id: str, ids: tuple[int, int, int] | None = None) -> dict:
    """Copy the field template, isolate names/uids, and bind IDs when known."""
    validate_run_id(run_id)
    data = copy.deepcopy(template)
    _require_safe_project(data["project"])
    stem = f"APIDOC_VERIFY_{run_id}"
    data["group"]["name"] = stem + "_group"
    data["ordinary_process"]["name"] = stem + "_ordinary"
    data["multipass_process"]["name"] = stem + "_multipass"
    project_payload = data["project"]
    project_payload["name"] = stem + "_project"
    project_payload["project"]["name"] = stem + "_project"
    project_payload["project"]["uid"] = stem + "_project"

    # The saved reference project is not a planned task. For this single-line
    # multi-pass example, future NEW project payloads need explicit coplanar mode.
    global_source = data["ordinary_process"]["global_process"]
    global_keys = ("enable_offset_correction", "target_accuracy_threshold", "smoothing_parameters", "planning_parameters", "enable_free_pose", "enable_input_safe_point")
    future_global = {key: copy.deepcopy(global_source[key]) for key in global_keys}
    for key in ("enable_offset_correction", "enable_free_pose", "enable_input_safe_point"):
        if type(future_global[key]) is not int:
            raise ValidationError("global process flag must be integer: " + key)
    threshold = future_global["target_accuracy_threshold"]
    if type(threshold) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(threshold) or threshold <= 0:
        raise ValidationError("global accuracy threshold must be finite and positive")
    for key in ("smoothing_parameters", "planning_parameters"):
        if not isinstance(future_global[key], str):
            raise ValidationError("global planning parameters must be strings")
    future_global["coplanarity_check_mode"] = 1
    project_payload["workpieces"][1]["global_process"] = future_global

    process_ids = None if ids is None else ids[1:]
    node_number = 0
    for index, workpiece in enumerate(project_payload["workpieces"], 1):
        workpiece["name"] = f"{stem}_workpiece{index}"
        workpiece["uid"] = f"{stem}_workpiece{index}"
        if process_ids is not None:
            workpiece["process_class_id"] = ids[0]
            workpiece["weld_process_id"] = process_ids[index - 1]
        for node in workpiece["nodes"]:
            if not isinstance(node, dict):
                raise ValidationError("every workpiece node must be an object")
            node_number += 1
            node["name"] = f"{stem}_seam{node_number}"
            node["uid"] = f"{stem}_seam{node_number}"
            if process_ids is not None:
                node["process_class_id"] = ids[0]
                node["weld_process_id"] = process_ids[index - 1]

    if ids is not None:
        group_id, ordinary_id, multipass_id = ids
        if any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in ids):
            raise ValidationError("created IDs must be positive integers")
        data["ordinary_process"]["class_id"] = str(group_id)
        data["multipass_process"]["class_id"] = str(group_id)
        # Keep the explicit assignments visible: these are the only process IDs
        # allowed in the two ordered workpiece branches.
        project_payload["workpieces"][0]["weld_process_id"] = ordinary_id
        project_payload["workpieces"][1]["weld_process_id"] = multipass_id
    return data


def _reply_dict(reply) -> dict:
    return {
        key: getattr(reply, key)
        for key in ("status", "data", "message", "result")
        if hasattr(reply, key)
    }


def _print_exchange(step: str, endpoint: str, request: dict, reply) -> None:
    print(json.dumps({"step": step, "endpoint": endpoint, "request": request}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({"step": step, "response": _reply_dict(reply)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))


def _accepted(reply, step: str) -> None:
    if getattr(reply, "status", None) != 200:
        raise ValidationError(f"{step} rejected: raw={_reply_dict(reply)!r}")


def _decimal_data_id(reply, step: str) -> int:
    _accepted(reply, step)
    try:
        value = json.loads(reply.data)["id"]
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isascii() or not value.isdecimal():
            raise ValueError("id is not an ASCII decimal string")
        parsed = int(value)
        if parsed <= 0:
            raise ValueError("id is not positive")
        return parsed
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError(f"{step} returned invalid data.id: {getattr(reply, 'data', None)!r}") from exc


def _project_ids(reply) -> tuple[int, list[int]]:
    _accepted(reply, "project_add")
    try:
        data = json.loads(reply.data)
        project_id = data["project_id"]
        workpiece_ids = data["workpieceIds"]
        if type(project_id) is not int or project_id <= 0:
            raise ValueError("project_id must be a positive integer")
        if not isinstance(workpiece_ids, list) or len(workpiece_ids) != 2:
            raise ValueError("workpieceIds must contain two ordered entries")
        if any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in workpiece_ids):
            raise ValueError("workpieceIds entries must be positive integers")
        return project_id, workpiece_ids
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError(f"project_add returned invalid data: {getattr(reply, 'data', None)!r}") from exc


def _create_records(template: dict, run_id: str, client, service_type, partial: dict) -> dict:
    """Four creates plus mandatory readback; 200+IDs alone do not prove commit."""
    prepared = prepare_payloads(template, run_id)

    group_request = prepared["group"]
    print(json.dumps({"step": "group_add", "endpoint": "/at/data/process_class_add", "request": group_request}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    group_reply = client.process_class_add(group_request)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "group_add", "response": _reply_dict(group_reply)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
    group_id = _decimal_data_id(group_reply, "group_add")
    partial["group_id"] = group_id

    ordinary_request = prepared["ordinary_process"]
    ordinary_request["class_id"] = str(group_id)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "ordinary_process_add", "endpoint": "/at/data/process_add", "request": ordinary_request}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ordinary_reply = client.process_add(ordinary_request)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "ordinary_process_add", "response": _reply_dict(ordinary_reply)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
    ordinary_id = _decimal_data_id(ordinary_reply, "ordinary_process_add")
    partial["ordinary_id"] = ordinary_id

    multipass_request = prepared["multipass_process"]
    multipass_request["class_id"] = str(group_id)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "multipass_process_add", "endpoint": "/at/data/process_add", "request": multipass_request}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    multipass_reply = client.process_add(multipass_request)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "multipass_process_add", "response": _reply_dict(multipass_reply)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
    multipass_id = _decimal_data_id(multipass_reply, "multipass_process_add")
    partial["multipass_id"] = multipass_id

    bound = prepare_payloads(template, run_id, (group_id, ordinary_id, multipass_id))
    project_request = {"id": "", "data": json.dumps(bound["project"], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))}
    print(json.dumps({"step": "project_add", "endpoint": "/at/data/workpiece_task_add", "request": project_request}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    project_reply = client.call(service_type, "/at/data/workpiece_task_add", project_request, timeout=5)
    print(json.dumps({"step": "project_add", "response": _reply_dict(project_reply)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
    project_id, workpiece_ids = _project_ids(project_reply)
    partial.update(project_id_unverified=project_id, workpiece_ids_unverified=workpiece_ids)
    detail_request = {"id": str(project_id), "data": ""}
    print(json.dumps({"step": "project_readback", "endpoint": "/at/data/workpiece_task_detail", "request": detail_request}, ensure_ascii=False))
    detail_reply = client.call(service_type, "/at/data/workpiece_task_detail", detail_request, timeout=5)
    _print_exchange("project_readback", "/at/data/workpiece_task_detail", detail_request, detail_reply)
    verify_project_readback(detail_reply, bound["project"], project_id, workpiece_ids)
    result = {
        "verified_by_readback": True,
        "group_id": group_id,
        "ordinary_process_id": ordinary_id,
        "multipass_process_id": multipass_id,
        "project_id": project_id,
        "workpiece_ids_in_request_order": workpiece_ids,
        "task_submitted": False,
        "task_started": False,
    }
    print(json.dumps({"created": result}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print("禁止现场提交：本示例到工程数据库创建即停止，不提供任务 Action、启动或控制路径。")
    return result


def verify_project_readback(reply, expected: dict, project_id: int, workpiece_ids: list[int]) -> None:
    """Reject a plausible 200 reply if the aggregate was rolled back or mismatched."""
    _accepted(reply, "project_readback")
    try:
        data = json.loads(reply.data)
        project = data["project"]
        if project["id"] != str(project_id) or data["task_name"] != expected["name"]:
            raise ValueError("project identity/name mismatch")
        for key in ("name", "uid", *SAFE_SWITCHES):
            if type(project[key]) is not type(expected["project"][key]) or project[key] != expected["project"][key]:
                raise ValueError("project strategy mismatch: " + key)
        workpieces = data["workpieces"]
        if len(workpieces) != len(workpiece_ids):
            raise ValueError("workpiece count mismatch")
        for index, (actual, wanted) in enumerate(zip(workpieces, expected["workpieces"])):
            if type(actual["id"]) is not int or actual["id"] != workpiece_ids[index]:
                raise ValueError("workpiece ID order mismatch")
            for key in ("name", "uid", "weld_process_id", "process_class_id"):
                if type(actual[key]) is not type(wanted[key]) or actual[key] != wanted[key]:
                    raise ValueError("workpiece binding mismatch: " + key)
            if actual.get("global_process") != wanted.get("global_process"):
                raise ValueError("global process readback mismatch")
            if len(actual["nodes"]) != len(wanted["nodes"]):
                raise ValueError("node count mismatch")
            for node, wanted_node in zip(actual["nodes"], wanted["nodes"]):
                for key in ("name", "uid", "weld_process_id", "process_class_id"):
                    if type(node[key]) is not type(wanted_node[key]) or node[key] != wanted_node[key]:
                        raise ValueError("node binding mismatch: " + key)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError("Project outcome untrusted: mandatory readback mismatch; do not retry or submit") from exc


def create_records(template: dict, run_id: str, client, service_type) -> dict:
    partial = {}
    try:
        return _create_records(template, run_id, client, service_type, partial)
    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps({"partial_creation": partial, "remaining_outcome": "untrusted or unknown; inspect read-only", "retry": False, "cleanup": False}, ensure_ascii=False))
        raise


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_INPUT)
    parser.add_argument("--create", action="store_true", help="perform the four database create calls")
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", help="required isolated ASCII nonce for --create")
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="", help="test/mocking namespace only; leave empty on the field controller")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    template = load_template(args.input)
    if not args.create:
        print("OFFLINE PLAN: no ROS call is made. Full confirmed field template follows:")
        print(json.dumps(template, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        print(
            "Online mode performs four database creates, verifies the project by a read-only query, then stops; "
            "even with direct_run=0 this example never sends a task Action or start/control call."
        )
        return 0
    if not args.run_id:
        parser.error("--create requires --run-id")
    validate_run_id(args.run_id)
    if args.prefix and args.prefix != "/api_field_create_mock":
        parser.error("--prefix is reserved for the isolated /api_field_create_mock namespace")
    from aotai_sdk import Client
    from weld_interfaces.srv import ATStringGeneric

    try:
        with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
            create_records(template, args.run_id, client, ATStringGeneric)
        return 0
    except Exception as exc:
        text = str(exc).lower()
        if "timed out" in text or "timeout" in text or "state unknown" in text:
            print(f"OUTCOME UNKNOWN: create request may have reached the server; stopped without retry/cleanup: {exc}")
        else:
            print(f"CREATE STOPPED: no retry/cleanup is attempted: {exc}")
        return 3


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

完整示例文件：examples/cpp/field_create.cpp

#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <weld_interfaces/srv/at_string_generic.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <regex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

using Json = aotai_sdk::json;

namespace {
const char *kDefaultInput = "examples/data/field-create-templates.json";
const std::regex kRunId("[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,47}");

Json load_json(const std::string &path) {
  std::ifstream input(path);
  if (!input)
    throw std::runtime_error("cannot open template: " + path);
  Json data;
  input >> data;
  if (!data.is_object())
    throw std::invalid_argument("template root must be an object");
  return data;
}

void validate_template(const Json &root) {
  for (const auto *key : {"reference_environment", "group", "ordinary_process",
                          "multipass_process", "project"})
    if (!root.contains(key) || !root.at(key).is_object())
      throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("template.") + key +
                                  " must be an object");
  const auto &payload = root.at("project");
  if (!payload.contains("project") || !payload.at("project").is_object())
    throw std::invalid_argument("template.project.project must be an object");
  const auto &project = payload.at("project");
  for (const auto *key : {"direct_run", "loop_execution", "need_reservation",
                          "need_digital_start"})
    if (!project.contains(key) || !project.at(key).is_number_integer() ||
        project.at(key).get<int>() != 0)
      throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("project.") + key +
                                  " must be integer 0");
  if (!payload.contains("workpieces") || !payload.at("workpieces").is_array() ||
      payload.at("workpieces").size() != 2)
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "template.project.workpieces must contain ordinary and multipass entries");
  for (const auto &workpiece : payload.at("workpieces"))
    if (!workpiece.is_object() || !workpiece.contains("nodes") ||
        !workpiece.at("nodes").is_array() || workpiece.at("nodes").empty())
      throw std::invalid_argument("every workpiece must contain nodes");
}

Json prepare(Json root, const std::string &run_id, int group_id = 0,
             int ordinary_id = 0, int multipass_id = 0) {
  if (!std::regex_match(run_id, kRunId))
    throw std::invalid_argument(
        "--run-id must be 1..48 ASCII safe characters and start alphanumeric");
  validate_template(root);
  const std::string stem = "APIDOC_VERIFY_" + run_id;
  root["group"]["name"] = stem + "_group";
  root["ordinary_process"]["name"] = stem + "_ordinary";
  root["multipass_process"]["name"] = stem + "_multipass";
  auto &payload = root["project"];
  payload["name"] = stem + "_project";
  payload["project"]["name"] = stem + "_project";
  payload["project"]["uid"] = stem + "_project";
  // Future NEW projects: exact supported single-line multi-pass global object.
  // Do not rewrite the actual saved reference dataset or claim it was planned.
  const auto &global_source = root.at("ordinary_process").at("global_process");
  Json future_global = Json::object();
  for (const auto *key : {"enable_offset_correction", "target_accuracy_threshold", "smoothing_parameters", "planning_parameters", "enable_free_pose", "enable_input_safe_point"})
    future_global[key] = global_source.at(key);
  for (const auto *key : {"enable_offset_correction", "enable_free_pose", "enable_input_safe_point"})
    if (!future_global.at(key).is_number_integer())
      throw std::invalid_argument("global process flags must be integers");
  const auto &threshold = future_global.at("target_accuracy_threshold");
  if (!threshold.is_number() || !std::isfinite(threshold.get<double>()) || threshold.get<double>() <= 0)
    throw std::invalid_argument("global accuracy threshold must be finite and positive");
  for (const auto *key : {"smoothing_parameters", "planning_parameters"})
    if (!future_global.at(key).is_string())
      throw std::invalid_argument("global planning parameters must be strings");
  future_global["coplanarity_check_mode"] = 1;
  payload["workpieces"][1]["global_process"] = future_global;
  const int process_ids[2] = {ordinary_id, multipass_id};
  std::size_t seam = 0;
  for (std::size_t index = 0; index < payload["workpieces"].size(); ++index) {
    auto &workpiece = payload["workpieces"][index];
    const std::string suffix = "_workpiece" + std::to_string(index + 1);
    workpiece["name"] = stem + suffix;
    workpiece["uid"] = stem + suffix;
    if (process_ids[index] > 0) {
      workpiece["process_class_id"] = group_id;
      workpiece["weld_process_id"] = process_ids[index];
    }
    for (auto &node : workpiece["nodes"]) {
      if (!node.is_object())
        throw std::invalid_argument("every node must be an object");
      ++seam;
      node["name"] = stem + "_seam" + std::to_string(seam);
      node["uid"] = stem + "_seam" + std::to_string(seam);
      if (process_ids[index] > 0) {
        node["process_class_id"] = group_id;
        node["weld_process_id"] = process_ids[index];
      }
    }
  }
  if (group_id > 0) {
    root["ordinary_process"]["class_id"] = std::to_string(group_id);
    root["multipass_process"]["class_id"] = std::to_string(group_id);
  }
  return root;
}

Json reply_json(const aotai_sdk::GenericReply &reply) {
  return {{"status", reply.status}, {"data", reply.data},
          {"message", reply.message}, {"result", reply.result}};
}

int decimal_id(const aotai_sdk::GenericReply &reply, const std::string &step) {
  if (!reply.accepted())
    throw std::runtime_error(step + " rejected: " + reply_json(reply).dump());
  try {
    const auto text = Json::parse(reply.data).at("id").get<std::string>();
    if (text.empty() || !std::all_of(text.begin(), text.end(), [](char ch) {
          return ch >= '0' && ch <= '9';
        }))
      throw std::invalid_argument("not decimal");
    std::size_t consumed = 0;
    const auto value = std::stoll(text, &consumed);
    if (consumed != text.size() || value <= 0 ||
        value > std::numeric_limits<int>::max())
      throw std::out_of_range("not positive int");
    return static_cast<int>(value);
  } catch (const std::exception &) {
    throw std::runtime_error(step + " returned invalid data.id: " + reply.data);
  }
}

std::pair<int, Json> project_ids(
    const weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric::Response::SharedPtr &reply) {
  if (reply->status != 200)
    throw std::runtime_error("project_add rejected: status=" +
                             std::to_string(reply->status) + " message=" +
                             reply->message + " data=" + reply->data);
  try {
    const auto data = Json::parse(reply->data);
    const auto &raw_id = data.at("project_id");
    if (!raw_id.is_number_integer() || raw_id <= 0 || raw_id > std::numeric_limits<int>::max())
      throw std::invalid_argument("project_id must be a positive bounded integer");
    const int project_id = raw_id.get<int>();
    const auto &workpiece_ids = data.at("workpieceIds");
    if (project_id <= 0 || !workpiece_ids.is_array() ||
        workpiece_ids.size() != 2)
      throw std::invalid_argument("invalid project id collection");
    for (const auto &id : workpiece_ids)
      if (!id.is_number_integer() || id.get<int>() <= 0)
        throw std::invalid_argument("invalid workpiece id");
    return {project_id, workpiece_ids};
  } catch (const std::exception &) {
    throw std::runtime_error("project_add returned invalid data: " + reply->data);
  }
}

void verify_readback(const Json &data, const Json &expected, int project_id,
                     const Json &workpiece_ids) {
  const auto &project = data.at("project");
  if (project.at("id") != std::to_string(project_id) ||
      data.at("task_name") != expected.at("name"))
    throw std::runtime_error("project readback identity/name mismatch");
  for (const auto *key : {"name", "uid", "direct_run", "loop_execution", "need_reservation", "need_digital_start"})
    if (project.at(key).type() != expected.at("project").at(key).type() ||
        project.at(key) != expected.at("project").at(key))
      throw std::runtime_error("project readback strategy mismatch");
  const auto &workpieces = data.at("workpieces");
  if (!workpieces.is_array() || workpieces.size() != workpiece_ids.size())
    throw std::runtime_error("project readback workpiece count mismatch");
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < workpieces.size(); ++i) {
    const auto &actual = workpieces.at(i);
    const auto &wanted = expected.at("workpieces").at(i);
    if (!actual.at("id").is_number_integer() || actual.at("id") != workpiece_ids.at(i))
      throw std::runtime_error("project readback workpiece ID order mismatch");
    for (const auto *key : {"name", "uid", "weld_process_id", "process_class_id"})
      if (actual.at(key) != wanted.at(key))
        throw std::runtime_error("project readback workpiece binding mismatch");
    if (actual.at("global_process") != wanted.at("global_process"))
      throw std::runtime_error("global process readback mismatch");
    if (actual.at("nodes").size() != wanted.at("nodes").size())
      throw std::runtime_error("project readback node count mismatch");
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < actual.at("nodes").size(); ++j)
      for (const auto *key : {"name", "uid", "weld_process_id", "process_class_id"})
        if (actual.at("nodes").at(j).at(key) != wanted.at("nodes").at(j).at(key))
          throw std::runtime_error("project readback node binding mismatch");
  }
}

void print_request(const std::string &step, const std::string &endpoint,
                   const Json &request) {
  std::cout << Json{{"step", step}, {"endpoint", endpoint}, {"request", request}}.dump(2)
            << '\n';
}
} // namespace

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  bool create = false;
  std::string input_path = kDefaultInput, run_id, prefix;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    const std::string option = argv[i];
    if (option == "--create")
      create = true;
    else if (option == "--input" && i + 1 < argc)
      input_path = argv[++i];
    else if (option == "--run-id" && i + 1 < argc)
      run_id = argv[++i];
    else if (option == "--prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
      prefix = argv[++i];
    else {
      std::cerr << "usage: field_create [--input FILE] [--create --run-id ID] "
                   "[--prefix MOCK_PREFIX]\n";
      return 2;
    }
  }
  int calls_started = 0;
  Json partial = Json::object();
  try {
    const Json source = load_json(input_path);
    validate_template(source);
    if (!create) {
      std::cout << "OFFLINE PLAN: no ROS call is made. Full confirmed field "
                   "template follows:\n"
                << source.dump(2)
                << "\nOnline mode performs four database creates plus mandatory readback and "
                   "then stops; even with direct_run=0 it never sends a task "
                   "Action or start/control call.\n";
      return 0;
    }
    if (run_id.empty())
      throw std::invalid_argument("--create requires --run-id");
    if (!prefix.empty() && prefix != "/api_field_create_mock")
      throw std::invalid_argument(
          "--prefix is reserved for /api_field_create_mock");
    Json prepared = prepare(source, run_id);
    aotai_sdk::Client client(prefix);

    print_request("group_add", "/at/data/process_class_add", prepared["group"]);
    ++calls_started;
    const auto group_reply = client.process_class_add(prepared["group"]);
    std::cout << Json{{"step", "group_add"}, {"response", reply_json(group_reply)}}.dump(2) << '\n';
    const int group_id = decimal_id(group_reply, "group_add");
    partial["group_id"] = group_id;

    prepared["ordinary_process"]["class_id"] = std::to_string(group_id);
    print_request("ordinary_process_add", "/at/data/process_add",
                  prepared["ordinary_process"]);
    ++calls_started;
    const auto ordinary_reply = client.process_add(prepared["ordinary_process"]);
    std::cout << Json{{"step", "ordinary_process_add"}, {"response", reply_json(ordinary_reply)}}.dump(2) << '\n';
    const int ordinary_id = decimal_id(ordinary_reply, "ordinary_process_add");
    partial["ordinary_id"] = ordinary_id;

    prepared["multipass_process"]["class_id"] = std::to_string(group_id);
    print_request("multipass_process_add", "/at/data/process_add",
                  prepared["multipass_process"]);
    ++calls_started;
    const auto multipass_reply = client.process_add(prepared["multipass_process"]);
    std::cout << Json{{"step", "multipass_process_add"}, {"response", reply_json(multipass_reply)}}.dump(2) << '\n';
    const int multipass_id = decimal_id(multipass_reply, "multipass_process_add");
    partial["multipass_id"] = multipass_id;

    const Json bound = prepare(source, run_id, group_id, ordinary_id, multipass_id);
    auto request = std::make_shared<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric::Request>();
    request->id = "";
    request->data = bound.at("project").dump();
    print_request("project_add", "/at/data/workpiece_task_add",
                  {{"id", request->id}, {"data", request->data}});
    ++calls_started;
    const auto project_reply =
        client.call<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric>(
            "/at/data/workpiece_task_add", request, std::chrono::seconds(5));
    std::cout << Json{{"step", "project_add"},
                     {"response", {{"status", project_reply->status},
                                    {"data", project_reply->data},
                                    {"message", project_reply->message}}}}.dump(2)
              << '\n';
    const auto ids = project_ids(project_reply);
    partial["project_id_unverified"] = ids.first;
    partial["workpiece_ids_unverified"] = ids.second;
    auto detail_request = std::make_shared<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric::Request>();
    detail_request->id = std::to_string(ids.first);
    detail_request->data = "";
    print_request("project_readback", "/at/data/workpiece_task_detail",
                  {{"id", detail_request->id}, {"data", ""}});
    const auto detail = client.call<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric>(
        "/at/data/workpiece_task_detail", detail_request, std::chrono::seconds(5));
    std::cout << Json{{"step", "project_readback"}, {"response", {{"status", detail->status}, {"data", detail->data}, {"message", detail->message}}}}.dump(2) << '\n';
    if (detail->status != 200)
      throw std::runtime_error("Project outcome untrusted: readback rejected");
    verify_readback(Json::parse(detail->data), bound.at("project"), ids.first, ids.second);
    std::cout << Json{{"created", {{"verified_by_readback", true}, {"group_id", group_id},
                                     {"ordinary_process_id", ordinary_id},
                                     {"multipass_process_id", multipass_id},
                                     {"project_id", ids.first},
                                     {"workpiece_ids_in_request_order", ids.second},
                                     {"task_submitted", false},
                                     {"task_started", false}}}}.dump(2)
              << "\n禁止现场提交：本示例到工程数据库创建即停止，不提供任务 Action、启动或控制路径。\n";
    client.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const aotai_sdk::Error &error) {
    std::cerr << Json{{"partial_creation", partial}, {"retry", false}, {"cleanup", false}}.dump() << '\n';
    const bool uncertain =
        calls_started > 0 &&
        (error.kind == aotai_sdk::ErrorKind::timeout ||
         error.kind == aotai_sdk::ErrorKind::communication ||
         error.kind == aotai_sdk::ErrorKind::closed);
    std::cerr << (uncertain ? "OUTCOME UNKNOWN: " : "CREATE STOPPED: ")
              << "stopped without retry/cleanup: " << error.what() << '\n';
    return 3;
  } catch (const std::exception &error) {
    std::cerr << Json{{"partial_creation", partial}, {"retry", false}, {"cleanup", false}}.dump() << '\n';
    std::cerr << "CREATE STOPPED: no retry/cleanup: " << error.what() << '\n';
    return 3;
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Welder configuration, connection and control example; offline by default.

Demonstration inputs are restricted to the isolated mock namespace.
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from aotai_sdk import AotaiClient, ApiError


def require_ok(response, label):
    if response.status != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{label}: status={response.status} message={response.message!r}"
        )
    print(
        f"{label}: status={response.status} result={getattr(response, 'result', None)!r} message={getattr(response, 'message', '')!r}"
    )


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--endpoint-prefix", default="")
    p.add_argument(
        "--input", default=str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "data/device-control.json")
    )
    args = p.parse_args()
    spec = json.loads(Path(args.input).read_text())
    if not args.execute:
        print(
            "offline: add --execute --endpoint-prefix /api_device_mock only for the isolated mock"
        )
        return 0
    if (
        spec.get("demonstration_only") is True
        and args.endpoint_prefix != "/api_device_mock"
    ):
        raise SystemExit(
            "refusing demonstration input outside /api_device_mock"
        )
    if spec.get("demonstration_only") is not True and not spec.get("site_confirmed"):
        raise SystemExit("refusing field input without site_confirmed:true")
    if not isinstance(spec.get("demonstration_only"), bool):
        raise ValueError("demonstration_only must be an explicit boolean")
    if spec["demonstration_only"] is False and spec.get("site_confirmed") is not True:
        raise ValueError("site_confirmed must be boolean true for field input")
    w = spec["welder"]
    try:
        with AotaiClient(endpoint_prefix=args.endpoint_prefix) as client:
            require_ok(client.welder_config("", w["config_data"]), "config")
            require_ok(client.welder_connect(w["weld_ip"], True), "connect")
            cert = client.welder_certify(w["certificate"])
            require_ok(cert, "certify")
            if cert.result != 1:
                raise RuntimeError("certify result is not 1")
            require_ok(client.welder_robot_ready(True), "robot_ready")
            require_ok(client.welder_current(w["current"]), "current")
            require_ok(client.welder_synergic_mode(w["synergic_mode"]), "synergic_mode")
            require_ok(client.welder_voltage(w["voltage"]), "voltage")
            enabled = client.welder_enable(w["enable"])
            require_ok(enabled, "enable")
            if enabled.result != w["enable"]:
                raise RuntimeError("enable cache bit does not match requested enable")
            require_ok(client.welder_welding(True), "welding_accept")
            arc = client.welder_status("is_arcing")
            require_ok(arc, "is_arcing")
            if arc.result != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "is_arcing is not 1; start request was only accepted"
                )
            require_ok(client.welder_welding(False), "welding_stop_accept")
            operating = client.welder_status("weld_operate")
            require_ok(operating, "weld_operate")
            if operating.result != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("weld_operate is not 0 after stop request")
            disabled = client.welder_enable(0)
            require_ok(disabled, "disable")
            if disabled.result != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("disable cache bit is not 0")
            require_ok(client.welder_robot_ready(False), "robot_not_ready")
    except ApiError as exc:
        print(f"SDK error: {exc}; raw={exc.raw!r}")
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

完整示例文件：examples/cpp/welder.cpp

#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
using aotai_sdk::Client;
using aotai_sdk::json;
static void check(const aotai_sdk::GenericReply &r, const char *step) {
  std::cout << step << ": status=" << r.status << " result=" << r.result
            << " message=" << r.message << "\n";
  if (r.status != 200)
    throw std::runtime_error(std::string(step) + " rejected");
}
static void
check_float(const weld_interfaces::srv::ATFloat::Response::SharedPtr &r,
            const char *step) {
  std::cout << step << ": status=" << r->status
            << " result=" << std::setprecision(17) << r->result
            << " message=" << r->message << "\n";
  if (r->status != 200)
    throw std::runtime_error(std::string(step) + " rejected");
}
// cppcheck-suppress constParameter -- keep the ISO C++ main signature.
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  bool execute = false;
  std::string prefix, input = "../../examples/data/device-control.json";
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    std::string a = argv[i];
    if (a == "--execute")
      execute = true;
    else if (a == "--endpoint-prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
      prefix = argv[++i];
    else if (a == "--input" && i + 1 < argc)
      input = argv[++i];
    else {
      std::cerr << "usage: welder [--execute --endpoint-prefix PREFIX] "
                   "[--input FILE]\n";
      return 64;
    }
  }
  if (!execute) {
    std::cout << "offline: no welder request is sent\n";
    return 0;
  }
  try {
    std::ifstream file(input);
    if (!file)
      throw std::runtime_error("cannot open input");
    json spec;
    file >> spec;
    if (!spec.contains("demonstration_only") ||
        !spec["demonstration_only"].is_boolean())
      throw std::runtime_error(
          "demonstration_only must be an explicit boolean");
    if (spec.value("demonstration_only", false) && prefix != "/api_device_mock")
      throw std::runtime_error("demonstration input is mock-only");
    if (!spec.value("demonstration_only", false) &&
        !spec.value("site_confirmed", false))
      throw std::runtime_error("field input requires site_confirmed:true");
    const auto &w = spec.at("welder");
    Client c(prefix);
    check(c.welder_config("", w.at("config_data")), "config");
    check(c.welder_connect(w.at("weld_ip"), true), "connect");
    auto certified = c.welder_certify(w.at("certificate"));
    check(certified, "certify");
    if (certified.result != 1)
      throw std::runtime_error("certify result is not 1");
    check(c.welder_robot_ready(true), "robot_ready");
    check_float(c.welder_current(w.at("current")), "current");
    check(c.welder_synergic_mode(w.at("synergic_mode")), "synergic_mode");
    check_float(c.welder_voltage(w.at("voltage")), "voltage");
    auto enabled = c.welder_enable(w.at("enable"));
    check(enabled, "enable");
    if (enabled.result != w.at("enable").get<long long>())
      throw std::runtime_error("enable cache bit mismatch");
    check(c.welder_welding(true), "welding_accept");
    auto arc = c.welder_status("is_arcing");
    check(arc, "is_arcing");
    if (arc.result != 1)
      throw std::runtime_error("start was accepted but arc is not confirmed");
    check(c.welder_welding(false), "welding_stop_accept");
    auto stopped = c.welder_status("weld_operate");
    check(stopped, "weld_operate");
    if (stopped.result != 0)
      throw std::runtime_error(
          "stop was accepted but weld_operate is not zero");
    auto disabled = c.welder_enable(0);
    check(disabled, "disable");
    if (disabled.result != 0)
      throw std::runtime_error("disable cache bit is not 0");
    check(c.welder_robot_ready(false), "robot_not_ready");
    c.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const std::exception &e) {
    std::cerr << "SDK/input error: " << e.what() << "\n";
    return 2;
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Robot configuration and control example; offline by default.

The i7 subtype is an example; use the configured model for your robot.
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from aotai_sdk import AotaiClient, ApiError


def ok(r, name):
    if r.status != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{name}: {r.status} {r.message!r}")
    print(
        f"{name}: status={r.status} result={getattr(r, 'result', None)!r} message={getattr(r, 'message', '')!r}"
    )


def parse_state(reply):
    try:
        state = json.loads(reply.data)
        if not isinstance(state, dict):
            raise ValueError("expected object")
        return state
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        raise RuntimeError(f"malformed robot status; raw={reply.data!r}") from error


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--endpoint-prefix", default="")
    p.add_argument(
        "--input", default=str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / "data/device-control.json")
    )
    a = p.parse_args()
    d = json.loads(Path(a.input).read_text())
    if not a.execute:
        print("offline: no robot request is sent")
        return 0
    if d.get("demonstration_only") is True and a.endpoint_prefix != "/api_device_mock":
        raise SystemExit(
            "refusing demonstration input outside /api_device_mock"
        )
    if d.get("demonstration_only") is not True and not d.get("site_confirmed"):
        raise SystemExit("refusing field input without site_confirmed:true")
    if not isinstance(d.get("demonstration_only"), bool):
        raise ValueError("demonstration_only must be an explicit boolean")
    if d["demonstration_only"] is False and d.get("site_confirmed") is not True:
        raise ValueError("site_confirmed must be boolean true for field input")
    r = d["robot"]
    step = r["step"]
    try:
        with AotaiClient(endpoint_prefix=a.endpoint_prefix) as c:
            ok(
                c.robot_init(
                    r["robot_type"],
                    r["robot_subtype"],
                    r["robot_ip"],
                    r["local_ip"],
                    r["robot_scope"],
                ),
                "init",
            )
            ok(c.robot_connect(True), "connect")
            power = c.robot_power(True)
            ok(power, "power")
            if power.message:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "power succeeded with a load/TCP warning; no motion is sent: "
                    + power.message
                )
            ok(c.robot_subscribe(), "subscribe")
            status = c.robot_status()
            ok(status, "status")
            state = parse_state(status)
            if not (
                state.get("connect_status")
                and state.get("power_status")
                and state.get("subscribe_status")
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("robot status does not confirm ready prerequisites")
            c.robot_pose()
            ok(
                c.robot_move_step(step["move_type"], step["direction"], step["speed"]),
                "move_step",
            )
            ok(c.robot_stop(), "move_stop")
            stopped = c.robot_status()
            ok(stopped, "status_after_stop")
            if parse_state(stopped).get("motion_status") not in (0, False):
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "move_stop accepted but motion status is not confirmed idle"
                )
    except (ApiError, ValueError, RuntimeError, TypeError, KeyError) as e:
        print(f"SDK error: {e}; raw={getattr(e, 'raw', None)!r}")
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

// The example subtype i7 must be replaced with the configured robot model.
// This is not model certification. Default execution remains offline.
#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
using aotai_sdk::Client;
using aotai_sdk::json;
static void check(const aotai_sdk::GenericReply &r, const char *step) {
  std::cout << step << ": status=" << r.status << " result=" << r.result
            << " message=" << r.message << "\n";
  if (r.status != 200)
    throw std::runtime_error(std::string(step) + " rejected");
}
// cppcheck-suppress constParameter -- keep the ISO C++ main signature.
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  bool execute = false;
  std::string prefix, input = "../../examples/data/device-control.json";
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    std::string a = argv[i];
    if (a == "--execute")
      execute = true;
    else if (a == "--endpoint-prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
      prefix = argv[++i];
    else if (a == "--input" && i + 1 < argc)
      input = argv[++i];
    else {
      std::cerr << "usage: robot [--execute --endpoint-prefix PREFIX] [--input "
                   "FILE]\n";
      return 64;
    }
  }
  if (!execute) {
    std::cout << "offline: no robot request is sent\n";
    return 0;
  }
  try {
    std::ifstream file(input);
    if (!file)
      throw std::runtime_error("cannot open input");
    json spec;
    file >> spec;
    if (!spec.contains("demonstration_only") ||
        !spec["demonstration_only"].is_boolean())
      throw std::runtime_error(
          "demonstration_only must be an explicit boolean");
    if (spec.value("demonstration_only", false) && prefix != "/api_device_mock")
      throw std::runtime_error("demonstration input is mock-only");
    if (!spec.value("demonstration_only", false) &&
        !spec.value("site_confirmed", false))
      throw std::runtime_error("field input requires site_confirmed:true");
    const auto &r = spec.at("robot");
    const auto &step = r.at("step");
    Client c(prefix);
    // Initialize/configure, then check every stage before sending a motion
    // request.
    check(c.robot_init(r.at("robot_type"), r.at("robot_subtype"),
                       r.at("robot_ip"), r.at("local_ip"), r.at("robot_scope")),
          "init");
    check(c.robot_connect(true), "connect");
    auto power = c.robot_power(true);
    check(power, "power");
    if (!power.message.empty())
      throw std::runtime_error(
          "power succeeded with a load/TCP warning; no motion is sent: " +
          power.message);
    check(c.robot_subscribe(), "subscribe");
    auto state = c.robot_status();
    check(state, "status");
    auto j = json::parse(state.data);
    if (!j.value("connect_status", false) || !j.value("power_status", false) ||
        !j.value("subscribe_status", false))
      throw std::runtime_error("robot state does not confirm prerequisites");
    auto pose = c.robot_pose();
    if (pose->cur_pos.size() != 6 || pose->joint_pos.size() != 6 ||
        pose->flan_pos.size() != 6)
      throw std::runtime_error("robot pose shape is invalid");
    check(c.robot_move_step(step.at("move_type"), step.at("direction"),
                            step.at("speed")),
          "move_step");
    check(c.robot_stop(), "move_stop");
    auto stopped = c.robot_status();
    check(stopped, "status_after_stop");
    const auto stop_state = json::parse(stopped.data);
    if (!stop_state.contains("motion_status") ||
        !stop_state["motion_status"].is_number_integer() ||
        stop_state["motion_status"].get<int>() != 0)
      throw std::runtime_error(
          "move_stop accepted but motion status is not confirmed idle; raw=" +
          stopped.data);
    c.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const std::exception &e) {
    std::cerr << "SDK/input error: " << e.what() << "\n";
    return 2;
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""VZ connect/config -> start capture -> stop capture. Download is a separate example."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import time
from pathlib import Path
from aotai_sdk import Client


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        type=Path,
        help="actual VZ connect JSON; guid from discovered camera",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not math.isfinite(args.seconds) or args.seconds <= 0:
        parser.error("--seconds must be finite and positive")
    if not args.execute:
        print(
            "Offline: --execute --config CONFIG.json starts/stops acquisition; no point cloud is downloaded automatically."
        )
        return 0
    if args.config is None:
        parser.error("--config is required for explicit acquisition")
    config = json.loads(args.config.read_text())
    if (
        not isinstance(config, dict)
        or config.get("command_type") != "connect"
        or not isinstance(config.get("guid"), str)
        or not config["guid"]
    ):
        parser.error("config needs command_type=connect and actual guid from discovery")
    with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
        reply = client.camera_config(json.dumps(config, ensure_ascii=False))
        print(reply.message)  # SDK checks the inner JSON status; keep driver details.
        reply = client.camera_config('{"command_type":"connect_status"}')
        status = json.loads(reply.message)
        if status.get("connect_status") != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"camera not connected; raw={reply.message!r}")
        print(client.camera_control('{"command_type":"start_capture"}').message)
        time.sleep(
            args.seconds
        )  # A capture interval, not evidence that points are ready.
        print(client.camera_control('{"command_type":"stop_capture"}').message)
        print(
            "Capture stop acknowledged. APP PCD file download uses HTTP; see docs/point-cloud-download.md. No frame/unit is inferred."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as error:
        print(
            f'ERROR: {error}; raw={getattr(error, "raw", None)!r}; acquisition outcome may be unknown'
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <thread>
// cppcheck-suppress constParameter -- standard main signature.
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  try {
    bool execute = false;
    std::string file, prefix;
    double seconds = 1.0;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
      const std::string option = argv[i];
      if (option == "--execute")
        execute = true;
      else if (option == "--config" && i + 1 < argc)
        file = argv[++i];
      else if (option == "--prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
        prefix = argv[++i];
      else if (option == "--seconds" && i + 1 < argc) {
        const std::string value = argv[++i];
        std::size_t consumed;
        seconds = std::stod(value, &consumed);
        if (consumed != value.size())
          throw std::invalid_argument("invalid seconds");
      } else
        throw std::invalid_argument("unknown or incomplete option");
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0)
      throw std::invalid_argument("seconds must be finite and positive");
    if (!execute) {
      std::cout << "Offline: --execute --config CONFIG.json starts/stops "
                   "acquisition, without downloading.\n";
      return 0;
    }
    if (file.empty())
      throw std::invalid_argument("--config required");
    std::ifstream input(file);
    if (!input)
      throw std::runtime_error("cannot open config");
    aotai_sdk::json config;
    input >> config;
    if (!config.is_object() || config.value("command_type", "") != "connect" ||
        !config.contains("guid") || !config["guid"].is_string() ||
        config["guid"].get<std::string>().empty())
      throw std::invalid_argument(
          "config needs command_type=connect and actual guid from discovery");
    aotai_sdk::Client client(prefix);
    auto check = [](const aotai_sdk::GenericReply &reply) {
      std::cout << reply.message << '\n';
      if (!reply.accepted())
        throw std::runtime_error("camera rejected: " + reply.message);
    };
    check(client.camera_config(config.dump()));
    auto status = client.camera_config("{\"command_type\":\"connect_status\"}");
    check(status);
    if (aotai_sdk::json::parse(status.message).value("connect_status", 0) != 1)
      throw std::runtime_error("camera not connected: " + status.message);
    check(client.camera_control("{\"command_type\":\"start_capture\"}"));
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::duration<double>(seconds));
    check(client.camera_control("{\"command_type\":\"stop_capture\"}"));
    std::cout << "Capture stop acknowledged. Download separately; frame/unit "
                 "metadata is not inferred.\n";
    client.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const std::exception &error) {
    std::cerr << error.what() << "; acquisition outcome may be unknown\n";
    return 2;
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read one process aggregate and its separately returned system configuration.

The default invocation is offline.  `--connect` performs only the two current
read services: ``/at/data/process_detail`` and
``/at/data/system_config_detail_by_process``.  It prints each service's ``data``
string unchanged.  This is deliberately not a process clone/update tool:
process_detail omits configParam, retains database-owned nested IDs, and cannot
be safely sent to process_add/process_info_update without constructing the required write
object.
"""

import argparse
import json


def positive_source_id(value):
    """Reject bools, floats, zero, and negatives before constructing a client."""
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
        raise ValueError("--source-id must be a positive integer")
    return value


def require_json_object(raw, label):
    """Check a response is a JSON object while returning its exact raw text."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} response data must be text; raw={raw!r}")
    try:
        decoded = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} response data is not JSON; raw={raw!r}") from error
    if not isinstance(decoded, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} response data must be a JSON object; raw={raw!r}")
    return raw


def read_process_responses(client, source_id, service_type):
    """Read both server views once; no automatic retry or write is performed."""
    positive_source_id(source_id)
    detail = client.process_detail(source_id)
    config = client.call(
        service_type,
        "/at/data/system_config_detail_by_process",
        {"id": str(source_id), "data": ""},
    )
    return (
        require_json_object(detail.data, "process_detail"),
        require_json_object(config.data, "system_config_detail_by_process"),
    )


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--connect", action="store_true", help="perform the two read-only service calls"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--source-id", type=int, help="positive existing process ID")
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="", help="isolated mock namespace only")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not args.connect:
        print(
            "Offline: use --connect --source-id ID to read two process responses; no DB write is available."
        )
        return 0
    try:
        positive_source_id(args.source_id)
    except ValueError as error:
        parser.error(str(error))

    # Delayed imports and construction keep offline/invalid CLI paths side-effect free.
    from aotai_sdk import ApiError, Client
    from weld_interfaces.srv import ATStringGeneric

    try:
        with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
            detail_raw, config_raw = read_process_responses(
                client, args.source_id, ATStringGeneric
            )
    except ApiError as error:
        print(f"process inspection failed: {error}; raw={error.raw}")
        return 3
    except ValueError as error:
        print(f"process inspection refused: {error}")
        return 3

    # Do not normalize or combine the two shapes: callers can save/review them
    # with all returned fields intact before using the dedicated data-creation workflow.
    print(f"process_detail.data={detail_raw}")
    print(f"system_config_detail_by_process.data={config_raw}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Process-group CRUD example; offline by default.

Execution is restricted to an isolated mock namespace. This example does not
create or update process aggregates; see docs/process-workflow.md.
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REPORT = ROOT / "examples/data/process-report-requests.json"


def created_id(reply):
    """ATStringGeneric add replies encode database id as a decimal string."""
    try:
        value = json.loads(reply.data)["id"]
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isascii() or not value.isdecimal():
            raise ValueError("id is not an ASCII decimal string")
        parsed = int(value)
        if parsed <= 0 or parsed > 2147483647:
            raise ValueError("id is not positive")
        return parsed
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"process_class_add returned no usable data.id: {reply.data!r}"
        ) from exc


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--prefix", default="")
    args = p.parse_args()
    cards = json.loads(REPORT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["blocks"]
    if not args.execute:
        print("Offline: example terminal calls:")
        for card in cards[:6]:
            print(card["text"])
        print(
            "This example does not submit process_add/update requests."
        )
        return 0
    if args.prefix != "/api_process_mock":
        p.error(
            "--execute is restricted to --prefix /api_process_mock in this delivery"
        )
    from aotai_sdk import Client

    # Keep the example group name and bind the returned ID.
    with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
        add = client.process_class_add({"name": "平角焊"})
        class_id = created_id(add)
        print(f"created process_class id={class_id}")
        client.process_class_update({"id": class_id, "name": "平焊"})
        rows = json.loads(client.process_class_list().data or "[]")
        print(
            f"class rows={len(rows)}; no process_add sent"
        )
        client.process_class_delete(class_id)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <weld_interfaces/srv/at_string_generic.hpp>

#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

namespace {
using aotai_sdk::json;

int positive_source_id(const char *text) {
  try {
    std::size_t parsed = 0;
    const int value = std::stoi(text, &parsed);
    if (parsed != std::string(text).size() || value <= 0)
      throw std::invalid_argument("not positive");
    return value;
  } catch (const std::exception &) {
    throw std::invalid_argument("--source-id must be a positive integer");
  }
}

const std::string &require_json_object(const std::string &raw, const char *label) {
  try {
    if (!json::parse(raw).is_object())
      throw std::invalid_argument("not an object");
  } catch (const std::exception &) {
    // Quote rather than normalize the server string, so diagnostics preserve
    // malformed/non-object data without making it executable JSON input.
    throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(label) +
                                " response data must be a JSON object; raw=" +
                                json(raw).dump());
  }
  return raw;
}

void usage() {
  std::cerr << "usage: process_inspect [--connect --source-id ID] [--prefix /mock]\n";
}
}  // namespace

// Default is offline. --connect only reads /at/data/process_detail and
// /at/data/system_config_detail_by_process; it never creates, updates, or
// retries a process database operation.
// cppcheck-suppress constParameter -- preserve the standard C++ main signature.
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  bool connect = false;
  std::string prefix;
  const char *source_text = nullptr;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    const std::string argument = argv[i];
    if (argument == "--connect")
      connect = true;
    else if (argument == "--source-id" && i + 1 < argc)
      source_text = argv[++i];
    else if (argument == "--prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
      prefix = argv[++i];
    else {
      usage();
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if (!connect) {
    std::cout << "Offline: use --connect --source-id ID to read two process "
                 "responses; no DB write is available.\n";
    return 0;
  }
  if (!source_text) {
    usage();
    return 2;
  }

  try {
    const int source_id = positive_source_id(source_text);
    aotai_sdk::Client client(prefix);
    const auto detail = client.process_detail(source_id);
    if (!detail.accepted()) {
      std::cerr << "process_detail rejected: " << detail.status << " "
                << detail.message << " raw=" << detail.data << "\n";
      return 3;
    }
    auto request = std::make_shared<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric::Request>();
    request->id = std::to_string(source_id);
    request->data = "";
    const auto config = client.call<weld_interfaces::srv::ATStringGeneric>(
        "/at/data/system_config_detail_by_process", request);
    if (config->status != 200) {
      std::cerr << "system_config_detail_by_process rejected: " << config->status
                << " " << config->message << " raw=" << config->data << "\n";
      return 3;
    }
    const auto &detail_raw = require_json_object(detail.data, "process_detail");
    const auto &config_raw =
        require_json_object(config->data, "system_config_detail_by_process");
    // Keep the two server-returned documents separate and byte-for-byte intact.
    std::cout << "process_detail.data=" << detail_raw << "\n";
    std::cout << "system_config_detail_by_process.data=" << config_raw << "\n";
    client.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const std::exception &error) {
    std::cerr << "process inspection failed: " << error.what() << "\n";
    return 3;
  }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <aotai_sdk/client.hpp>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

// Default mode does not create database rows. --execute only accepts the
// isolated mock prefix; this example does not create process aggregates.
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  bool execute = false;
  std::string prefix;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    if (std::string(argv[i]) == "--execute")
      execute = true;
    else if (std::string(argv[i]) == "--prefix" && i + 1 < argc)
      prefix = argv[++i];
    else {
      std::cerr
          << "usage: process_workflow [--execute --prefix /api_process_mock]\n";
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if (!execute) {
    std::cout
        << "Offline: example class_add data={\\\"name\\\":\\\"平角焊\\\"}; "
           "this example does not submit process_add/update requests.\n";
    return 0;
  }
  if (prefix != "/api_process_mock") {
    std::cerr << "--execute is restricted to --prefix /api_process_mock in "
                 "this delivery\n";
    return 2;
  }
  try {
    aotai_sdk::Client client(prefix);
    const auto add = client.process_class_add({{"name", "平角焊"}});
    if (!add.accepted())
      throw std::runtime_error(add.message);
    const auto id_text =
        aotai_sdk::json::parse(add.data).at("id").get<std::string>();
    if (id_text.empty() ||
        !std::all_of(id_text.begin(), id_text.end(),
                     [](unsigned char ch) { return ch >= '0' && ch <= '9'; }))
      throw std::invalid_argument(
          "process_class_add returned invalid decimal data.id");
    std::size_t consumed = 0;
    const long long parsed_id = std::stoll(id_text, &consumed);
    if (consumed != id_text.size() || parsed_id <= 0 ||
        parsed_id > std::numeric_limits<int>::max())
      throw std::invalid_argument(
          "process_class_add returned invalid positive data.id");
    const int id = static_cast<int>(parsed_id);
    const auto update =
        client.process_class_update({{"id", id}, {"name", "平焊"}});
    if (!update.accepted())
      throw std::runtime_error(update.message);
    const auto rows = client.process_class_list();
    if (!rows.accepted())
      throw std::runtime_error(rows.message);
    std::cout << "created/updated class id=" << id
              << "; group management only; no process_add sent\n";
    const auto remove = client.process_class_delete(id);
    if (!remove.accepted())
      throw std::runtime_error(remove.message);
    client.close();
    return 0;
  } catch (const std::exception &e) {
    std::cerr << "process workflow failed: " << e.what() << "\n";
    return 3;
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read the project/workpiece library; never rewrite detail as an update payload."""

import argparse
import json
from aotai_sdk import Client


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--connect", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=["project", "workpiece"], default="project")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--id", type=int, help="existing positive ID from the library list"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.id is not None and args.id <= 0:
        parser.error("--id must be positive; no format-only ID is executable")
    if not args.connect:
        print(
            "Offline. --connect lists the library; --connect --id ID reads a detail. No write path."
        )
        return 0
    from weld_interfaces.srv import ATQuery, ATStringGeneric

    stem = "/at/data/workpiece_task" if args.kind == "project" else "/at/data/workpiece"
    with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
        if args.id is None:
            reply = client.call(
                ATQuery,
                stem + "_list",
                {
                    "filters": [],
                    "page_number": 1,
                    "items_per_page": 20,
                    "sort_field": "id",
                    "sort_descending": True,
                },
            )
        else:
            reply = client.call(
                ATStringGeneric, stem + "_detail", {"id": str(args.id), "data": ""}
            )
        try:
            payload = json.loads(reply.data)
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                raise ValueError("expected JSON object")
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
            raise ValueError(
                f"malformed library response; raw={reply.data!r}"
            ) from error
        print(reply.data)  # Preserve original numeric/string IDs and nested arrays.
        print(
            "Read only: project.id/string and workpiece.welds/array need verified inverse mapping before update."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as error:
        print(f'ERROR: {error}; raw={getattr(error, "raw", None)!r}')
        raise SystemExit(2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Workpiece-group CRUD example; new IDs are read from creation responses.

Default execution is offline.  --execute is intentionally limited to the
isolated mock namespace; it never connects to a field database.
"""

import argparse
import json


def positive_decimal_id(reply):
    try:
        value = json.loads(reply.data)["id"]
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isascii() or not value.isdecimal():
            raise ValueError("id must be an ASCII decimal string")
        result = int(value)
        if result <= 0 or result > 2147483647:
            raise ValueError("id must be positive")
        return result
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"group add returned no usable data.id: {reply.data!r}"
        ) from exc


def require_clean_update(reply):
    # Current backend can map false (0) to status=200 while retaining message.
    if reply.status != 200 or reply.message:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"workpiece_group_update is not confirmed: status={reply.status} "
            f"message={reply.message!r} raw={reply.data!r}"
        )


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.execute:
        print(
            'Offline example commands: add data={"name":"分组-1"}; '
            'update data={"id":"6","name":"66"}; '
            "list sort_field=id sort_descending=false page=1 items=10; "
            'detail filters=[{key:id,value:"6"}]; delete id=7.'
        )
        print("Runtime uses the newly returned id, not the example IDs 6/7.")
        return 0
    if args.prefix != "/api_group_mock":
        parser.error("--execute is restricted to --prefix /api_group_mock")
    from aotai_sdk import Client

    with Client(endpoint_prefix=args.prefix) as client:
        # Keep the example names and bind the returned group ID.
        add = client.workpiece_group_add({"name": "分组-1"})
        group_id = positive_decimal_id(add)
        listing = client.workpiece_group_list(
            filters=[],
            page_number=1,
            items_per_page=10,
            sort_field="id",
            sort_descending=False,
        )
        detail = client.workpiece_group_detail(group_id)
        require_clean_update(
            client.workpiece_group_update({"id": str(group_id), "name": "66"})
        )
        client.workpiece_group_delete(group_id)
        print(
            f"created/listed/detailed/updated/deleted dynamic group id={group_id}; "
            f"list={listing.data!r}; detail={detail.data!r}"
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble the shared multi-pass JSON; --execute is deliberately guarded.

Run `python3 multipass.py [--input multipass-input.json]` to print a local
MCS_WeldTask JSON.  `--execute` additionally requires confirmed non-demo IDs,
coplanar mode and DB readback; it may submit an Action and is never default.
"""

import argparse, json, pathlib
from aotai_sdk import (
    Client,
    load_and_assemble,
    validate_execute_input,
    verify_process_order,
)

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).parents[1] / "data"
p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--input", default=str(root / "multipass-input.json"))
p.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
a = p.parse_args()
source = json.load(open(a.input, encoding="utf8"))
task = load_and_assemble(a.input)
print(json.dumps(task, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
if a.execute:
    validate_execute_input(source)
    with Client() as c:
        for seam in source["seams"]:
            detail = c.process_detail(seam["process_id"])
            # Contract input currently binds one process per seam; verify each before submit.
            verify_process_order(json.loads(detail.data), {**source, "seams": [seam]})
        h = c.submit_task(task, lambda fb: print("feedback:", fb.status_message))
        print("ROS goal accepted:", h.accepted)
        print(h.wait_result())
